title: A finite type module flat at a point of a locally finitely presented morphism is finitely presented at that point
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a locally finitely presented morphism a finite type module flat at a point is finitely presented at that point (statement lines 2878-2884, tag 05P8-adjacent). The proof applies the local structure statement to get an etale neighbourhood on which the pullback is finitely presented near the lifted point and then descends finite presentation along the flat, hence faithfully flat, local ring map, which is a localisation of an etale ring map. The descent step is the substance, so the claim is H2.
